name: Standard Interior Board
shortDescription: A fictional general-purpose lining board for the visible faces of the prototype interior walls.
keyFeatures: Represents a general interior wall lining
Creates a surface ready for the finishing stage
Shared by wall concepts without a specialist board priority

name: Acoustic Interior Board
shortDescription: A fictional interior lining board included in wall concepts where reducing transferred noise is a priority.
keyFeatures: Used as a visible wall lining layer
Relevant to the bedroom noise-reduction scenario
Works as part of a complete wall concept rather than alone

name: Moisture-Aware Interior Board
shortDescription: A fictional interior lining board used to explain moisture-conscious material selection for bathroom walls.
keyFeatures: Used as a visible wall lining layer
Relevant to the bathroom moisture scenario
Represents a moisture-focused board choice in this prototype

name: Acoustic Cavity Insulation
shortDescription: A fictional cavity layer used to explain how an interior wall concept can respond to unwanted noise.
keyFeatures: Positioned conceptually within the wall cavity
Relevant where acoustic comfort is the discovery priority
Presented as one part of a complete wall concept

name: Thermal Cavity Insulation
shortDescription: A fictional cavity layer used to connect thermal-comfort needs with an interior wall material concept.
keyFeatures: Positioned conceptually within the wall cavity
Relevant where thermal comfort is the discovery priority
Avoids project-specific performance or calculation claims

name: Interior Wall Stud
shortDescription: A fictional vertical framing component used to organize the layers of the prototype interior-wall systems.
keyFeatures: Represents the vertical part of the wall frame
Creates the conceptual cavity between board layers
Shared across the guided wall scenarios

name: Interior Wall Track
shortDescription: A fictional horizontal framing component representing the head and base boundaries of an interior wall frame.
keyFeatures: Represents the horizontal part of the wall frame
Works conceptually with vertical wall studs
Shared across the guided wall scenarios

name: Interior Joint Compound
shortDescription: A fictional finishing material used to explain the treatment of joints between interior lining boards.
keyFeatures: Represents part of the board-joint finishing stage
Paired conceptually with interior joint tape
Included to show that the system extends beyond its main layers

name: Interior Joint Tape
shortDescription: A fictional finishing material representing the tape used as part of treating joints between lining boards.
keyFeatures: Represents part of the board-joint finishing stage
Paired conceptually with interior joint compound
Shared across the guided wall scenarios
